title: methodNames
responsibility: Names the methods a service contract declares under a class and puts them in create, read, update, delete order.

inputs.name: within.name
inputs.description: A declared name such as Class.method.input.

inputs.name: within.owner
inputs.description: The class or member the name may be declared under.

inputs.name: within.whole
inputs.description: Whether the owner name itself also counts as within it.

inputs.name: methodsNamed.names
inputs.description: The declared names of a contract.

inputs.name: methodsNamed.owner
inputs.description: The class whose methods are wanted.

inputs.name: methodsNamed.whole
inputs.description: Whether a bare Class.method name counts, or only names under a method.

outputs.name: within
outputs.description: True when the name is under the owner, or is the owner when whole is set.

outputs.name: methodsNamed
outputs.description: The method names the declared names place on the class, in the order given.

outputs.name: orderedMethods
outputs.description: Each method once, create first, then read, find, update, delete, constructor, and the rest in their order.
